the hydrodynamic transport functions can be calculated directly in the hydrodynamic regime, without the need for a ``hydrodynamic'' limit, and that the hydrodynamic regime is not necessarily restricted to small values of the shear and/or bulk viscosity coefficients, as is often assumed in the literature.
